title: APO Filet with Smooth Sage-Pistachio Gravy
description: Steam-cooked tenderloin medallions meet a velvety sage gravy enriched with smooth pistachio paste.
equipment: Anova Precision Oven Gen 1 with food probe, bottom drip pan and middle wire rack

ingredients.name: center-cut beef tenderloin medallions
ingredients.note: Trim silver skin and visible fat; cut about 3/4 inch thick.

ingredients.name: low-sodium beef broth
ingredients.note: Use plain broth made from meat, bones and water without a vegetable seasoning blend.

ingredients.name: fresh sage leaves
ingredients.note: Keep whole to strain out later. Remove before serving.

ingredients.name: smooth unsalted pistachio paste
ingredients.note: Pure pistachios, unsweetened and free of nut pieces.

steps.title: Preheat the APO
steps.text: Fill the water tank and install the bottom drip pan. Preheat to 155°F with sous vide mode on, 100% steam, rear element on, top and bottom elements off. Set the food probe target to 145°F.

steps.title: Arrange the medallions
steps.text: Place {filet} unbagged in the shallow pan on the middle rack. Insert the probe from the side into the thickest center. Begin cooking immediately and set a separate 20-minute reminder for the first temperature check; respond sooner if the probe signals.

steps.title: Infuse the sage
steps.text: Meanwhile bring {sage} and {broth} to a gentle simmer in the HexClad over medium-low. Cover for 5 minutes, then lift out the leaves.

steps.title: Blend the pistachio base
steps.text: Loosen {paste} with a spoonful of the warm sage broth until smooth, then whisk it back into the skillet.

steps.title: Make the slurry
steps.text: Stir {starch} into {water} in a small cup until smooth.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.text: Bring the sauce base to a simmer. Whisk in the freshly stirred slurry and keep it bubbling gently for 1 minute, until it coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Finish with butter
steps.text: Swirl {butter} into the gravy off heat.

steps.title: Cook the filet
steps.text: Steam for about 25–50 minutes, checking at 20 minutes. Verify each center reaches 145°F.

steps.title: Rest in the juices
steps.text: Remove the pan and rest the medallions loosely covered in their juices for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve in ribbons
steps.text: Thinly slice the rested filet and fan it in shallow bowls. Ladle the pistachio gravy over the meat and between the slices.

notes: Make ahead: The sage broth can be infused and chilled a day ahead. Stir the pistachio paste well before measuring. For dairy-free gravy, leave out the finishing butter. Keep the nut garnish entirely smooth. Refrigerate promptly in shallow portions and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze the filet submerged in gravy for up to 6 weeks; whisk the sauce smooth after thawing. Fridge reheat: Place one portion and its sauce in a shallow covered dish. Install the APO bottom drip pan and preheat to 325°F, sous vide mode off, 60% steam, rear element on, top and bottom off. Insert the probe in the coldest center and set it to 165°F. Start checking after 12 minutes and heat to 165°F throughout. Freezer reheat: Thaw a single portion in the refrigerator overnight, then use the fridge reheating method. Stir the sauce until smooth. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 279 kcal, 34.4 g protein, 4.8 g total carbohydrate, 13.6 g fat, 0.9 g fiber, 89 mg sodium. Includes the measured broth and sauce. Sodium varies with your broth.
